answer: Picture identities as boats along a jetty: honest agents arrive on their own schedules, but a sybil fleet steered by one backend answers epoch-seeded probes in correlated bursts, sharing timing quirks and a telltale pigment in their phrasing. A correlation trellis scores how tightly a cluster co-moves under randomized challenges; tight clusters get throttled and earn slower. To shed that signature an attacker must run a genuinely independent inference stack per mask, multiplying compute and latency until one-mind-many-masks stops paying.
